chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Majiluwayh narrated to me, saying: My uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Ali from Isa ibn Abdillah from his father from his grandfather from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to the muezzin: Between the Adhan and the Iqamah, his reward is like that of the martyr who is covered in his blood in the way of Allah, the Exalted.
He (Ali) said: I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, indeed they choose the Adhan and Iqamah (for themselves or others).'
He said: 'No, a time will come upon people when they will cast the Adhan upon their weak ones; those are flesh that Allah has made unlawful for the Fire.'

key_terms.الْأَذَانِ: The Adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.الْإِقَامَهَ: The Iqamah, the second call to prayer signaling its start
key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنِ: The muezzin, one who calls the prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a muezzin between the Adhan and Iqamah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to emphasize the high status of the muezzin, equating the reward earned between the Adhan and Iqamah to that of a martyr drenched in blood, a comparison that underscores the spiritual intensity of this specific interval. The hadith further provides eschatological context, predicting a time when the role may be delegated to the 'weak' (du'afa), whose bodies are thereby granted protection from Hellfire, highlighting the transformative power of the call itself. This reflects the Shia scholarly view on the sanctity of the Adhan as a divine invitation that carries inherent merit for the caller.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali b. Majluwayh who said it was narrated to me by my uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad b. Ali from Isa b. Abdillah from his father from his grandfather from Ali (a.s.)
“No, a time will come when the responsibility of Azaan and Iqamah will be entrusted only to weak and helpless people.
Hence the fire of Hell is made unlawful on their weak flesh.”
